items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: Buddy Bolton was my age and started out when I started out... If he did, I never heard of him.

ctx.x: But to tell you, even so, Buddy Bolton was my age and started out when I started out. That'd be a colored band. That wouldn't be the first white band ever organized a ragtime band. No, no.
